$comment: Briefs for the section-catalog fill cohort. The demo cohort in theme-prompts.json exercises whatever archetypes its briefs happen to select, which leaves parts of the catalog with no screenshot and parts with only one. Each entry here pins the three site-wide assignments a build cannot otherwise be told — the header archetype (HEADER_ARCHETYPE), the hero recipe (HERO_RECIPE), and the footer archetype (patched into pages.json between the plan and the sections step) — so every archetype in the catalog reaches at least two captures. Build them with: php bin/build-catalog-cohort.php (then php bin/section-catalog.php). Assignment rules the entries respect: centered-masthead is refused over an image-led hero (cover-image media or an image surface); split-nav is refused on a one-page site, so its entries are multi-page; oversized-wordmark is refused whenever a front hero exists, which resolve() always has, so no entry can request it.

prompts.prompt: Create a website for Ledger & Frame, a two-person bookbinding and paper conservation workshop in Ghent. They repair old books for libraries and private collectors, and they teach a small binding course four times a year.
Create a website for Dunes & Pine, a nine-room guesthouse on the Baltic coast of Lithuania. Long empty beaches, pine forest, a sauna by the water, breakfast made from what the neighbours grow.
Create a website for The Quarter Sheet, an independent quarterly magazine about working life in small European port cities. Long-form reporting, one photographer per issue, printed on newsprint.

Create a website for Plain Terms, a two-person consultancy that rewrites insurance and utility contracts into language ordinary customers can read. No stock photography, no illustrations — the writing is the product.
Create a website for Atelier Verso, a Lisbon studio that designs and prints exhibition posters by hand on a 1960s flatbed press. Bold colour, big type, short runs for museums and music venues.
Create a website for Wrenfield Orchard, a family cider orchard in Herefordshire with forty apple varieties. They press once a year, sell at the gate, and open the barn for two weekends each autumn.

Create a website for Northlight Physiotherapy, a clinic in Tromsø treating skiers, climbers and fishing crews. Calm, factual, appointment-led, with a plain explanation of what each treatment involves.
Create a website for Marta Ilić, a luthier in Zagreb who builds classical guitars to order and restores instruments from the 1930s. One instrument at a time, an eighteen-month waiting list.
